verdicts.reason: A drops the sea photo entirely, a real fidelity loss, and leaves typographic orphans: '$89' sits alone on its own line, 'Sunday.' is orphaned and the headline is broken into three lines. Even so, it keeps a clean shared left edge and a clear headline → copy → CTA order. B shrinks the photo to a meaningless sliver at the bottom, pushes the logo to the right so it no longer lines up with the left-aligned copy, packs the text into the top third, leaves a large dead blue gap in the middle, and centres the CTA, which breaks the grid.
